units.source_text: 一块长长的木板滑了过来，撞在侧腹上。

en.t: A long wooden board slid over and struck him in the side.

units.source_text: 光环切断天空，停在那块板上。

en.t: The ring of light cut across the sky and came to rest on that board.

units.source_text: 他将活动不便的上半身扭过来，朝着背后的人们，苦苦地哀求：

en.t: He twisted his stiff upper body around and pleaded desperately with the people behind him:
